about_the_game:
The Shed is a narrative driven mystery game that unfolds in the confines of a forgotten garden and its long abandoned outbuilding. Left behind by people you never knew, this place is both inheritance and enigma weathered, quiet, and humming with a past that won't stay buried.

As you explore the overgrown corners and rusted walls, you'll uncover more than just memories. Dialogue unfolds through a worn command-line interface, and every decision has a weight. Actions ripple across timelines, subtly shifting the world around you. Sometimes, the garden is not what it seems briefly slipping into another form, another perspective just long enough to say something it couldn’t otherwise.

With a focus on atmosphere, emotional storytelling, and quiet discovery, The Shed invites you to trace the lines between memory, consequence, and identity all from one small patch of earth where time doesn't always move forward.

Every decision has been made, might cause an impact on weather, safety or maybe even time

short_description: A narrative mystery where time bends in a forgotten garden. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and alter the present through echoes of the past. Occasionally shifting into 2D to tell its story in unexpected ways, The Shed is quiet, emotional, and deeply atmospheric.
